title: Laredo police hold final Blue Santa toy sign-ups Monday and Tuesday
excerpt: The Laredo Police Department is holding its final Blue Santa sign-ups Monday and Tuesday, November 9 and 10, from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. at 4712 Maher Avenue. The program gives Christmas gifts to children 10 and younger.
content:
The Laredo Police Department is holding its final sign-ups for the annual Blue Santa toy program on Monday and Tuesday, November 9 and 10, from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. at 4712 Maher Avenue, according to KGNS.

Blue Santa provides Christmas gifts to children 10 years old and younger. Families signing up need to bring a valid parent ID, a report card for elementary-school children, and a birth certificate for children who are not yet in school, KGNS reported.

Officer Dora Aguilar explained the documents families need at sign-up. Roberto Vedia discussed fundraising for the gifts, including the department's annual 5K run, and said the community's help ensures children receive presents and a Merry Christmas, according to KGNS.

Gift distribution is set for December 17, from 5 to 9 p.m., at the Sames Auto Arena.

Sources: KGNS, November 9, 2026.
